ucs.title: [LLM] Sandworm GPO-Deployed Wiper via Task Scheduler Fan-Out from SYSVOL / C:\Windows Root
ucs.description: Hunts Sandworm's (Seashell Blizzard / GRU Unit 74455) signature destructive playbook: compromise of a Domain Controller, modification of a GPO to push a scheduled task, and near-simultaneous execution of a short-named binary from C:\Windows root, PerfLogs, ProgramData, or Users\Public on multiple hosts. This pattern was used to deploy HermeticWiper, CaddyWiper, Prestige ransomware (Iridium), and most recently RoarBat across Ukrainian government and CI networks.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.user) as user values(Processes.process_hash) as sha256 dc(Processes.dest) as host_count values(Processes.dest) as hosts from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="svchost.exe" (Processes.parent_process="*Schedule*" OR Processes.parent_process="*netsvcs*") (Processes.process_path="C:\\Windows\\*.exe" OR Processes.process_path="*\\PerfLogs\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\*") by Processes.process_name Processes.process_path _time span=1h
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| search NOT process_name IN ("svchost.exe","conhost.exe","wuauclt.exe","mscorsvw.exe","dllhost.exe","TiWorker.exe","wermgr.exe","ngen.exe","ngentask.exe")
| regex process_name="^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{3,14}\.exe$"
| where host_count >= 3
| sort - firstTime
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 60m;
let KnownGoodChild = dynamic([@"\svchost.exe",@"\conhost.exe",@"\wuauclt.exe",@"\mscorsvw.exe",@"\dllhost.exe",@"\TiWorker.exe",@"\wermgr.exe",@"\ngen.exe",@"\ngentask.exe",@"\taskhostw.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith @"\svchost.exe"
| where CommandLine has_any ("Schedule","netsvcs") or ParentProcessName has_any ("Schedule","netsvcs")
| where (NewProcessName matches regex @"(?i)^C:\\Windows\\[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{3,14}\.exe$")
     or NewProcessName has_any (@"\PerfLogs\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\Microsoft\")
| where not(NewProcessName has_any (KnownGoodChild))
| extend ProcessLeaf = tostring(split(NewProcessName, @"\")[-1])
| where ProcessLeaf matches regex @"^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{3,14}\.exe$"
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), HostCount = dcount(Computer), Hosts = make_set(Computer, 25), SampleCmd = any(CommandLine), SampleParentCmd = any(ParentProcessName)
    by ProcessLeaf, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMinutes)
| where HostCount >= 3
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Sandworm GPO-Deployed Wiper via Task Scheduler from Suspicious Path
id: 8d4a3f1c-7e2b-4c5d-9f8a-2b1c3d4e5f6a
status: experimental
description: Detects scheduled-task-spawned binaries with short opaque names executing from C:\Windows root, PerfLogs, ProgramData, or Users\Public — Sandworm's (GRU Unit 74455 / Seashell Blizzard) signature GPO-based wiper deployment pattern observed across HermeticWiper, CaddyWiper, Prestige, and RoarBat campaigns.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2022/02/28/cyberattacks-on-ukrainian-government-and-critical-infrastructure/
  - https://cert.gov.ua/article/39518
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/2022/03/01/isaacwiper-hermeticwizard-wiper-worm-targeting-ukraine/
author: SOC Detection Team
date: 2026/05/29
tags:
  - attack.t1053.005
  - attack.t1485
  - attack.t1484.001
  - attack.g0034
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\svchost.exe'
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
      - 'Schedule'
      - 'netsvcs'
  selection_path_windows_root:
    Image|re: '(?i)^C:\\Windows\\[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{3,14}\.exe$'
  selection_path_alt:
    Image|contains:
      - '\PerfLogs\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\ProgramData\Microsoft\'
  filter_known_children:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\svchost.exe'
      - '\conhost.exe'
      - '\wuauclt.exe'
      - '\mscorsvw.exe'
      - '\dllhost.exe'
      - '\TiWorker.exe'
      - '\wermgr.exe'
      - '\ngen.exe'
      - '\ngentask.exe'
      - '\taskhostw.exe'
  condition: selection_parent and (selection_path_windows_root or selection_path_alt) and not filter_known_children
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate software deployed via Group Policy scheduled tasks (vet by SHA256 + cert)
  - Custom domain logon scripts that drop helpers to PerfLogs/Public
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\svchost.exe OR *\\SVCHOST.EXE OR *\\Svchost.exe) (@ParentCommandLine:(*Schedule* OR *schedule* OR *SCHEDULE* OR *netsvcs* OR *NETSVCS*)) (@Image:(*\\Windows\\* OR *\\WINDOWS\\* OR *\\PerfLogs\\* OR *\\PERFLOGS\\* OR *\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\\USERS\\PUBLIC\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\* OR *\\PROGRAMDATA\\MICROSOFT\\*)) -@Image:(*\\svchost.exe OR *\\SVCHOST.EXE OR *\\conhost.exe OR *\\CONHOST.EXE OR *\\wuauclt.exe OR *\\mscorsvw.exe OR *\\dllhost.exe OR *\\DLLHOST.EXE OR *\\TiWorker.exe OR *\\wermgr.exe OR *\\ngen.exe OR *\\taskhostw.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/svchost\.exe/i
| regex("(?i)(Schedule|netsvcs)", field=ParentCommandLine)
| regex("(?i)(^[a-z]:\\\\Windows\\\\[a-z0-9_-]{3,14}\\.exe$|\\\\(PerfLogs|Users\\\\Public|ProgramData\\\\Microsoft)\\\\)", field=ImageFileName)
| NOT ImageFileName=/\\(svchost|conhost|wuauclt|mscorsvw|dllhost|TiWorker|wermgr|ngen|ngentask|taskhostw)\.exe$/i
| FileName=/^[a-z0-9_-]{3,14}\.exe$/i
| groupBy([SHA256HashData, FileName], function=[count(field=aid, distinct=true, as=host_count), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), collect([ComputerName, CommandLine, ParentCommandLine])])
| host_count >= 3
| sort(field=firstSeen, order=desc)

ucs.title: [LLM] HermeticWiper / Sandworm EaseUS Partition Driver Loaded by Non-Vendor Process
ucs.description: Detects abuse of the legitimately-signed EaseUS Partition Master kernel driver (empntdrv.sys / emp_vN.sys / epmntdrv.sys) by a process outside the EaseUS install directory. HermeticWiper, IsaacWiper, and CaddyWiper — all attributed to Sandworm — drop this driver to obtain raw disk handles and overwrite the MBR / partition table, bypassing user-mode wipe protections.
ucs.splunk:
`wineventlog_system` EventCode=7045
| search (ServiceFileName="*empntdrv.sys" OR ServiceFileName="*emp_v9.sys" OR ServiceFileName="*emp_v8.sys" OR ServiceFileName="*epmntdrv.sys" OR ServiceName IN ("empntdrv","emp_v9","emp_v8","epmntdrv"))
| search NOT ServiceFileName="*\\Program Files\\EaseUS\\*" NOT ServiceFileName="*\\Program Files (x86)\\EaseUS\\*"
| stats min(_time) as firstTime values(ServiceName) as svc_name values(ServiceFileName) as svc_path values(AccountName) as installed_by values(host) as host by ComputerName
| sort - firstTime
| append [
  | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd values(Processes.process_path) as proc_path from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("empntdrv.sys","emp_v9.sys","emp_v8.sys","epmntdrv.sys") by Processes.dest Processes.process_name Processes.process_path
  | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
  | search NOT proc_path="*\\EaseUS\\*"
  | sort - firstTime
]
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WiperDrivers = dynamic(["empntdrv","emp_v9","emp_v8","epmntdrv"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 7045   // service installed
| where ServiceFileName has_any (WiperDrivers) or ServiceName has_any (WiperDrivers)
| where ServiceFileName !contains @"\Program Files\EaseUS"
| where ServiceFileName !contains @"\Program Files (x86)\EaseUS"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ServiceName, ServiceFileName, ServiceType, ServiceStartType, ServiceAccount
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: HermeticWiper / Sandworm EaseUS Partition Driver Loaded by Non-Vendor Process
id: 3c5e7d9a-1b2f-4a6c-8e3d-5f7a9c1d2e4b
status: experimental
description: Detects load of the EaseUS Partition Master kernel driver (empntdrv.sys / emp_v8.sys / emp_v9.sys / epmntdrv.sys) by a process outside the EaseUS install directory. HermeticWiper, IsaacWiper, and CaddyWiper — all attributed to Sandworm (GRU Unit 74455 / Seashell Blizzard / Iron Viking) — abuse this legitimately-signed driver to obtain raw disk handles and overwrite MBR / partition tables.
references:
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/2022/03/01/isaacwiper-hermeticwizard-wiper-worm-targeting-ukraine/
  - https://www.sentinelone.com/labs/hermetic-wiper-ukraine-under-attack/
  - https://blog.talosintelligence.com/threat-advisory-hermeticwiper/
author: SOC Detection Team
date: 2026/05/29
tags:
  - attack.t1561.002
  - attack.t1485
  - attack.t1014
  - attack.g0034
logsource:
  category: driver_load
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ImageLoaded|endswith:
      - '\empntdrv.sys'
      - '\emp_v9.sys'
      - '\emp_v8.sys'
      - '\epmntdrv.sys'
  filter_vendor_path:
    Image|contains:
      - '\Program Files\EaseUS\'
      - '\Program Files (x86)\EaseUS\'
  filter_vendor_processes:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\epm.exe'
      - '\PartitionManager.exe'
      - '\EaseUS.exe'
      - '\EaseUSPartitionMaster.exe'
      - '\epm-tray.exe'
  condition: selection and not (filter_vendor_path or filter_vendor_processes)
falsepositives:
  - Standalone / portable EaseUS Partition Master executed from a non-standard install path (vet by signature + parent)
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:6 @ImageLoaded:(*\\empntdrv.sys OR *\\EMPNTDRV.SYS OR *\\Empntdrv.sys OR *\\emp_v9.sys OR *\\EMP_V9.SYS OR *\\emp_v8.sys OR *\\EMP_V8.SYS OR *\\epmntdrv.sys OR *\\EPMNTDRV.SYS) -@Image:(*\\Program?Files\\EaseUS\\* OR *\\Program?Files?(x86)\\EaseUS\\* OR *\\epm.exe OR *\\EPM.EXE OR *\\PartitionManager.exe OR *\\EaseUS.exe OR *\\EaseUSPartitionMaster.exe OR *\\epm-tray.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/\\(empntdrv|emp_v[89]|epmntdrv)\.sys$/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\(EaseUS|epm|PartitionManager|EaseUSPartitionMaster|epm-tray)/i
| NOT TargetFileName=/\\Program\sFiles(\s\(x86\))?\\EaseUS\\/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName, ContextProcessId], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen)])
| sort(field=firstSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: The EaseUS Partition Master driver (empntdrv.sys / emp_vN.sys / epmntdrv.sys) is a vendor-signed kernel driver legitimately used by EaseUS's partition tool but trivially weaponized as a BYOVD raw-disk primitive — and Sandworm has done so consistently: HermeticWiper (Feb 2022), IsaacWiper (Feb 2022), and CaddyWiper (Mar 2022) all drop and load this exact driver to bypass user-mode wipe protections
